_comment: ModelArray GAM analysis — NODDI ICVF, longitudinal 3-group design
_formula_note: delta_age: time from baseline (ses-1) in years, NOT demeaned (leave out of continuous_covariates)
group, participant, sex → renamed to group_F, participant_F, sex_F by the runner script
s(delta_age, by=group_F, k=3): group-specific smooth trajectory of ICVF over time
participant_F: fixed subject factor — absorbs between-subject variance (repeated measures)
formula: icvf_dwimap ~ s(delta_age, by=group, k=3) + group + participant + sex
